title: Pixel — An AI Draws. Can You Guess?
description:
Name that movie. You've got 15 seconds.

Play Pixel: https://pixel.justinpaulson.com

Pixel is a drawing-and-guessing game where AI makes the art and everyone guesses. Play solo or invite friends. Pick movies, TV shows, songs, pop stars, video games, places, or everyday objects. Every round gets a freshly generated SVG drawing.

Built by Justin Paulson.
Project: https://justinpaulson.com/projects/pixel
Code: https://github.com/justinpaulson/pixel_bot

This trailer features drawings generated by Pixel, custom motion graphics, and an original synthesized soundtrack.

#Pixel #IndieGame #GuessTheDrawing
project_description: Pixel draws. You guess. An AI creates a fresh SVG illustration each round, and everyone races to name it in 15 seconds—even the host. Play solo or invite friends, with categories spanning movies, TV shows, songs, pop stars, video games, places, and everyday objects. Built with Rails, Solid Cable, and Solid Queue.
